feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is valid: five sensors at x = -0.02 to +0.02 (10 mm spacing) and y = 0.03 are inside range, sensor_size 0.012 is an allowed option, the weights are antisymmetric in [-2, 2], and kp, ki, kd, base_speed, mass and line_loss are in range. Nothing is obviously broken.

Iteration 6 (best raced, 115.8) kept 8 mm footprints, kp 3.0, ki 0.4, kd 0.45 and base 1.2. Every design so far (iterations 0 to 6) ended off_track on all 180 trials, with max_error at 0.061 to 0.068 and 1 to 2 line-loss events per run. The footprint has never been tested with the iteration 6 gains. Iteration 0 used 12 mm, but its 12 mm spacing and other gains confound that result (score 26.0), so the footprint effect is still open.

The candidate changes several things at once: footprint 8 to 12 mm, kd 0.45 to 0.35, mass 0.7 to 0.6, base_speed 1.2 to 1.3. The race will not isolate each effect. I am approving because this is iteration 7 of 12, the change is a clean test of sensing span and footprint against the best gains, and telemetry from it is worth more than a revision made without it. The next critique should follow the race. If line_loss_events fall to 1 or fewer and max_error drops below 0.06 on oval and s-bend, keep the 12 mm footprint and move base_speed toward 1.5 if progress is below about 0.5. If max_error still reaches 0.06 with line loss, the footprint is not the limit: raise kp (3.0 to 3.5) before adding kd, as iterations 4 to 6 suggest. If steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.28 (the iteration 6 level) with kd 0.35, the jitter is coming from the wider signal, so lower kp slightly before raising kd. If the result is worse than iteration 6 while line loss is lower, the lower centre gain from the sharper footprint is the likely cause, so restore kp toward 3.5.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events are 1 or fewer but max_error stays at or above 0.06, raise kp from 3.0 toward 3.5 with the 12 mm footprint and kd 0.35 held, because iterations 0 to 6 show the robot loses the tape at bends rather than oscillating (steering_oscillation about 0.1 to 0.28).

If the robot holds the line but oval progress stays below about 0.5 (iteration 6 reached 0.49), raise base_speed from 1.3 toward 1.5, since iteration 1 at base 1.5 showed the course needs roughly 1.5 m/s to finish and iteration 6 at base 1.2 lost progress.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.28 with kd 0.35 while max_error is still near 0.06, lower kp slightly before raising kd, because iteration 1 showed kd raising jitter and iteration 6 reached 0.28 at kd 0.45.
